title: Natural occupation measures of critical FK interfaces
exact_target: For each $q\in [1,4)$, can a positive deterministic c(q) normalize the vertex occupation measure of its critical square-lattice FK Dobrushin interface by $c(q)n^{-d}$, $d=1+\kappa (q)/8$, so that curve and measure converge jointly to one chordal SLE sample and its natural Minkowski-content measure, in ordered curve and weak finite-measure topologies?
